title: 小鹏机器人：毛利高过汽车，明年数万台交付能兑现吗？
speaker: Brian Gu

segments.en: Okay, so what sort of skills can Iron do better, maybe Brian? And how does having a car business help, whether it's through sheer trips, chips, I should say, shared AI and shared factories, too?
segments.zh: 好的，那么Iron在哪些技能上表现更优呢，Brian？拥有汽车业务又有何帮助，无论是通过行程、芯片，还是共享AI和共享工厂？

segments.en: Well, I think it's all of the buff, because first of all, the reason that we actually are able to develop Iron is actually build upon our physical AI core that we have developed for autonomous driving technology in Smart EV.
segments.zh: 我认为这些都是优势，因为首先，我们能够开发Iron，实际上是基于我们为智能电动汽车的自动驾驶技术所开发的物理AI核心。

segments.en: As you know, we have been developing full stack capabilities, actually having our own chip, our own model, our own training tools as well as the AI infrastructure to train the data that necessary for, you know, really advancing the model.
segments.zh: 如你所知，我们一直在开发全栈能力，拥有自己的芯片、自己的模型、自己的训练工具以及AI基础设施，来训练真正推进模型所需的数据。

segments.en: So that really, you know, capability coupled with as a EV in our manufacturer, we actually have advanced manufacturing ability to manage large sophisticated supply chain as well as understanding the power train needs to, you know, really in a robotic form.
segments.zh: 因此，这种能力加上我们作为电动汽车制造商，我们拥有先进的制造能力来管理大型复杂供应链，并理解动力总成的需求，真正以机器人形式呈现。

segments.en: So all of those capability, I would say, a very synergistic to our core EV business as well as the autonomous driving stack that we're developing.
segments.zh: 所以所有这些能力，我认为都与我们的核心电动汽车业务以及我们正在开发的自动驾驶栈非常协同。

segments.en: Yeah, so Iron goes on sale, second quarter of next year, Brian, you've also said that when it comes to robots that they can actually earn higher margins than cars.
segments.zh: 是的，Iron将于明年第二季度上市，Brian，你还说过，在机器人方面，它们实际上可以比汽车获得更高的利润率。

segments.en: How do you see the volume ramp shaping up? And when do you think robots are going to become a more meaningful part of your revenue?
segments.zh: 你如何看待销量爬坡的形势？你认为机器人何时会成为你收入中更有意义的部分？

segments.en: Well, I think, you know, next year will be a critical year for scale up and commercialization.
segments.zh: 我认为，明年将是规模扩大和商业化的关键一年。

segments.en: We see the delivery potentially in the tens of thousands for human robots.
segments.zh: 我们预计人形机器人的交付量可能达到数万台。

segments.en: We see actually robots will be similarly priced to average, shall we say medium priced EV.
segments.zh: 我们认为机器人的定价将与中等价位的电动汽车相似。

segments.en: But it was much higher margin growth margin for the hardware.
segments.zh: 但硬件的利润增长要高得多。

segments.en: But in addition, I would say robot because it requires a lot of the upgrade training as well as data infrastructure support.
segments.zh: 此外，机器人业务需要大量升级训练和数据基础设施支持。

segments.en: I think there's meaningful revenue opportunities outside of how we're sell.
segments.zh: 我认为除了销售之外，还有可观的收入机会。

segments.en: So that's, I would say a very exciting part of the business world's curve that we see.
segments.zh: 所以，我认为这是我们看到的业务增长曲线中非常令人兴奋的部分。
